start: export PATH="$PWD/.revolte/node/bin:$PATH"; NODE_ENV=development npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4173

install.name: Node.js runtime
install.run: mkdir -p .revolte/node && curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt -o .revolte/node/SHASUMS256.txt && arch=$(uname -m) && case "$arch" in x86_64) arch=x64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac; while read -r checksum filename; do case "$filename" in *-linux-"$arch".tar.xz) curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/"$filename" -o .revolte/node/runtime.tar.xz && actual=$(sha256sum .revolte/node/runtime.tar.xz) && [ "${actual%% *}" = "$checksum" ] && tar -xJf .revolte/node/runtime.tar.xz -C .revolte/node --strip-components=1 && rm .revolte/node/runtime.tar.xz .revolte/node/SHASUMS256.txt && exit 0; exit 1 ;; esac; done < .revolte/node/SHASUMS256.txt; exit 1

install.name: Application dependencies
install.check: export PATH="$PWD/.revolte/node/bin:$PATH"; test -f node_modules/.package-lock.json && test package-lock.json -ot node_modules/.package-lock.json && node -e "require('next/package.json'); require('better-sqlite3')"
